It counts touches the way a camera can — breaks between free ball flights, the ball lost while it overlaps a player's blob — because that camera misses touches: on our own matches rendered into the tracker's format it counts 78% of the tier-5 bot's true touches and 48% of the tier-0 bot's.

It counts touches the way a camera can — breaks between free ball flights, the ball lost while it overlaps a player's blob — because that camera misses touches: on our own matches rendered into the tracker's format it counts 78% of the tier-5 bot's true touches and 48% of the tier-0 bot's. An entry = the visible ball coming within 110 px of the CPU's head centre from outside (at most one per 0.5 s); converted = a CPU touch within 1 s.
note: How much of what reaches it the CPU plays: the five-star CPU 70%, the weak ones under half.
